value.rationale: Thermodynamic covariance matrix inversion needs a reliable mapping from an observed equilibrium covariance to the SPD matrix. This theorem determines its entire non-identifiable inverse fiber, shows that optimal deterministic Euler relaxation can maximally erase spatial anisotropy not just at equilibrium but at every one-time Gaussian snapshot from zero, and gives a two-step-size remedy. The exact border and whole-fiber geometry matter for model identifiability and numerical step selection beyond a routine bias expansion. It makes no unsupported claims about actual finite-sample estimators or broad classes of SDEs.
